summary: In February 2026, Boise State University reported several notable incidents, including a violation of a protection order and multiple thefts, with a significant focus on narcotics violations and alcohol-related offenses. Compared to previous months, there has been an increase in narcotics-related incidents, particularly concerning fentanyl and Percocet, as well as a rise in alcohol violations across campus locations. The disposition of many cases remains open, indicating ongoing investigations, while several cases from January were resolved or closed by referral. This pattern suggests a need for heightened awareness and preventive measures regarding substance-related issues on campus.
